Eclipse Quirk.name: Eclipse Quirk
Eclipse Quirk.description:
🌗 You make real light and shape real shadow, and each one feeds the other.

🧬 A Fusion Quirk of Light and Shadow Manipulation: each side at about half a single Quirk's reach, plus moves only the fusion can do.
🌱 At the start you fire a ten-meter beam that stretches its target's shadow, and bind someone about five meters away in glow-edged shadow bands.
📈 With training: shadow-edged cutting rays, five-meter steps between shadows, a flare that pins every foe's shadow, a strobe that blacks out a room, a total eclipse over a street.
⚠️ Mirrors bounce your light, smoke scatters it and cover stops it.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Sensory Overload, as your own strobes leave spots in your vision.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Output +10, Infiltration +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Corona Ray, Sundial Snare
🛡️ Resists: light
Eclipse Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: real light (hands or chest) and real cast shadow as material. New adult user: a searing beam about 10 m, a small-group dazzle; within 5 m, shadow raised into bands that bind unhurt and steps between shoulder-wide shadows. Limits: mirrors bounce light, smoke scatters it, cover stops it; floodlights thin shadows not from own light. Quirk Strain: light: beam, bind; moderate: cutting ray, shadow step, flare pin; heavy: strobe blackout, searing beam; severe: signature street eclipse, room sanctuary. Fusion: Light + Shadow Manipulation at half each's range and brightness; lacks district floods, block-long beams, block-wide shadow control; only it casts hard shadows in bright rooms, swallows glare, strobes both. Type: Emitter. Law: unlicensed eye-beams or shadow binds: assault or unlawful restraint. Look: own shadow shrinks.
